```
Normalized (16-token avg):
p50 latency: Redwood-hosted ~11ms vs public API ~32ms
```

- Vs LLM APIs: "APIs are great for PoCs; production needs predictable routing and fallbacks."
- Vs infra vendors: "DIY hosting requires ongoing ops; we provide the serving product with SLOs and autoscale."
